name: com.pg.inventory-system
description: Bag, items, crafting, dropped and placeable items with save, plus the items and craft menu views from World without Time. Requires com.pg.menu, com.pg.localization-system, com.pg.save-system, com.pg.audio-management, com.pg.notifications, com.pg.interact-system and com.pg.pgtween. Connects to the day cycle and to placing things in the world through InventoryBridge.
author: Lucia Lunadottir
